{{summary | book=14 
|chapter=23
|title=At the Edge of Time
|icon=web
|setting=[[Kandor]], [[Thakan'dar]], [[Pit of Doom]]
}}

<br />

:{{pov|[[Gawyn Trakand]]}}
Gawyn, looking for an escape, scouts ahead while leaving his warder’s cloak on [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] who is following not far behind. He tells her that he will toss a stone as a warning if he finds anything. He slips on one of the [[Bloodknife ring|rings]] of the [[Bloodknife|Bloodknives]] and becomes nearly invisible, especially in shadow. He reminds himself not to let the power of the ring make him too bold as it also gives him a little extra speed.

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene follows behind Gawyn. She begins to worry about [[Demandred]] leading the [[Sharan|Sharans]], whether enough [[Aes Sedai]] survived to face him, and why he sent for [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]]. She reminds herself that her strength and authority come from her control, understanding, and care and not merely her ability to channel. As she encourages herself, she hears Gawyn tossing pebbles. She crouches by a half-burned tent and sees the gruesome corpse of a burned [[:Category:Shienar (people)|Shienaran]], wearing a [[Children of the Light|Whitecloak]]. She senses a channeler behind her moments before a shield is slammed between her and the Source. Egwene attacks with her belt knife, but the tall, slender Sharan woman binds her with Air. Helpless, Egwene allows her terror to build to alert Gawyn through their bond.  She feels him moving closer, but still far off. [[Egeanin Tamarath|Leilwin]] knocks the channeler unconscious by smashing her head and rescues Egwene. Gawyn and [[Bayle Domon|Bayle]] rejoin the women, Gawyn explaining he was slowed down by having to defeat several of the Sharans. They quietly escape the outskirts of the camp and Egwene feels safe enough to create a gateway to [[Skimming|Skim]] to the [[The White Tower|White Tower]].

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
The assault on Thakan'dar begins. Aviendha leads a two-pronged attack of [[Asha'man|Ash'aman]], [[Aiel]] [[Wise One|Wise Ones]], the freed ''[[damane]]'' [[Alivia]], and ten of the [[Dragonsworn]] Aes Sedai with their [[Warder|Warders]] into the valley to destroy the [[Forger|Shadow-forgers]] and release their captives. The surprise attack catches the [[Shadowspawn]] off guard which allows [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]], [[Thom Merrilin|Thom]], and Rand to slip into the [[Pit of Doom]]. [[Rodel Ituralde]] moves his forces in behind the [[Aiel]] to secure the rest of the valley. Suddenly, the sun is eclipsed by something dark and solid. It strikes awe and fear of the end of the world in all those present. The darkness then moves and the sun is again visible, providing hope the world has not yet ended.

Aviendha feels strong channeling from the opposite side of the valley. She organizes a circle and floods with the One Power. A loose, raw weave of Air and Fire burns from her hands across the other side of the valley. Aviendha is careful to channel weaves of Fire, but not [[balefire]] to avoid further weakening the [[Bore]]. But the other channelers shoot back bars of balefire, heedlessly. Aviendha creates a gateway behind them and immediately shields herself with chunk of rock from another blast of balefire. As it disintegrates, the men and women of her circle dash through the gateway behind her. Cracks into pure darkness form in the rocks nearby, showing damage to the pattern itself. Aviendha burns a column of fire through a coppery-skinned [[Domani]]. Two women channelers remain and they throw weaves back and forth. The stronger woman{{ref|The most likely, it was [[Hessalam|Hessalam's]] shift to [[Tel'aran'rhiod]] in the flesh. [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin|Cadsuane]] thinks it was Traveling based on True Power, but it is described differently later.}} just vanishes without using a gateway, as if folding in on herself and leaving an odd tremble to the air. The last woman screams upon being abandoned from their circle and Aviendha tears off her limbs with a weave. 

In the aftermath, [[Bera Harkin]] heals Aviendha's singed eyes and [[Sarene Nemdahl]] confirms the two dead women as [[Duhara Basaheen]] and [[Falion Bhoda]] who had been raised from the Black Ajah to [[Dreadlords]]. She asks the others if they recognized the third woman but none do, saying they would have remembered a woman that ugly. Aviendha splits the single circle into three smaller circles led by herself, Bera, and Amys. One circle will provoke the Trollocs and reveal their channeler, while the other two circles conceal themselves then attack from the sides. She senses increased channeling activity as [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin|Cadsuane]] leads Aes Sedai and Asha'man, opening gateways for Domani and [[Tairen]] armies. Anticipating a mess of channeling, she establishes [[Traveling]] grounds and maintains tight control over channelers to pinpoint attacks by the [[Forsaken]].

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand approaches the base of the mountain that is Shayol Ghul. He orders no channeling until the strike on the Dark one to conserve his strength. Thom volunteers to guard the entrance into the cave, while joking about his excellent view of the battle and the chance to compose a ballad or two. Rand smiles at Thom's ability to smile even at the end of time itself.

[[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] suggests that Rand should rest, eyeing the old wound in his side that has re-opened. His blood runs down his leg and into his boot, leaving a bloody footprint behind:
:''The Dragon’s blood stains the rock of Shayol Ghul'' {{ref|From The [[Karaethon Cycle]]}}

He unsheathes [[Callandor]] and asks Moiraine and Nynaeve to form a circle. Moiraine asks if one of the women should lead to allow him to use Callandor safely. Rand replies that he doesn't intend to be safe, to Moiraine and Nynaeve's dismay. While he leads the circle, he remains vulnerable to another's strike that might seize control of him. As Rand questions whether he planned this well enough and whether it was the right time, a voice booms:

{{Quote|IT IS TIME. LET THE TASK BE UNDERTAKEN.}}

Moiraine gasps, eyes open wide but Rand is not surprised, as he had heard this voice once before now. He had been hoping for it.
